decision.reason: Preserve current UniversalTraits source intent, cost, numbers, and cadence while repairing state, domain, copy, and proof defects.

engine_anchors.proves: setter writes raw criticalChance; getter multiplies raw criticalChance by sharpness when present
non-empty item modData has a save/load path

resolution.enemy_enumeration: Trait-local transactional pcall returns only a completed count. Any receiver failure yields inactive state and restoration; no partial list/count is consumed.
resolution.weapon_state: State is keyed by weapon identity and reused across duplicate module loads. Inactive, Mundane, error, unequip, and swap restore all previously tracked weapons.
resolution.restoration: Removes the recorded Action Hero raw-field delta from the current raw value instead of restoring a stale cached scalar.
resolution.sharpness_domain: Converts displayed getter space to raw setter space with current sharpness, applies +15 and cap in displayed space, and safely skips nonpositive sharpness.
resolution.duplicate_load: UTCore._actionHeroState survives repeated source evaluation, retaining restoration ownership.
resolution.copy: English description now states threshold, range, +15 percentage points, 100 cap, 30 player updates, and Mundane suppression; stale damage and tier claims were removed.
resolution.save_reload: Current-version reload remains required. No claim is made that HandWeapon.criticalChance serializes; item modData evidence is explicitly bounded and the new runtime does not use UT_ahBaseCrit.
resolution.handler_lifecycle: Opt-in teardown restores tracked weapons before unregister; Action Hero reload replaces all prior callbacks and leaves one registration.
resolution.deactivation_cleanup: Active-set removal and invalid/dead-player teardown restore all outstanding Action Hero modifications.
resolution.mock_dispatch: The focused mock dispatches every matching registered handler and asserts callback counts.
